title: M3 vs M2 is the primary comparison
decision: The primary comparison is M3 vs M2, using the paired change in time-dependent AUC plus calibration.

title: No univariable significance screening
decision: Candidate proteins are not pre-filtered by univariable significance.

title: Preprocessing learned within training folds
decision: All preprocessing is learned within the training folds of the nested cross-validation.

title: Prediction horizon fixed after follow-up audit and before model comparison
decision: The horizon is fixed after the follow-up audit and before any model comparison.

title: 2- and 5-year exclusion sensitivity analyses
decision: Sensitivity analyses exclude diagnoses within 2 and within 5 years of baseline.
